name: Citizenship by Birth and Presumption

requirement_groups.name: Citizenship by birth (parent is a citizen)

requirements.blocker_text: Either the mother or the father is or was, at the date of the applicant's birth, a citizen of Kenya -- applies regardless of where the child is born.
A child found in Kenya who is, or appears to be, under 8 years of age, and whose nationality and parents are not known, is presumed to be a citizen by birth.

evidence_required.document: Parent's proof of Kenyan citizenship (birth track)

sources.title: Directorate of Immigration Services, Republic of Kenya -- Citizenship: birth citizenship where either parent is a Kenyan citizen at the time of birth (gender-neutral, regardless of birth location); a child found in Kenya under 8 years old with unknown nationality and parents is presumed a citizen by birth

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kenya). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Directorate of Immigration Services). GENUINE POSITIVE FINDING: birth citizenship is explicitly gender-neutral ('either the mother or father'), consistent with Kenya's 2010 Constitution's broader gender-equality provisions -- unlike the many one-directional gendered citizenship provisions found elsewhere in this dataset (Qatar, Bahrain, Nigeria, Sudan, Somalia, and Pakistan's marriage route specifically). dual_citizenship_allowed set to TRUE -- Kenya's 2010 Constitution and the Kenya Citizenship and Immigration Act 2011 affirmatively permit dual citizenship (with a disclosure obligation: a Kenyan who acquires another nationality must disclose it within 3 months), a marked contrast to India, Somalia's 1962 statute, and several other countries built in this dataset that prohibit or heavily restrict it.
